book.name: Ibulu
book.title: Ŋwa wù ba gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Ba'ibulu le

content: Kintanyɛ kì Jiso gɛ̀ ge le ki jo wa kijusɛ ki bintanyɛ bichii

Banchi ba Nyo gɛ̀ nya Musɛ le gɛ̀ bee kinjiinyi ki mwɛɛ mù njoŋe mù gɛ̀ bee ki mu tô mu nyûme. Gɛ bo gɛ̀ bee wa nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ wu mwɛɛ mù gɛ̀ bee ki mu tô mu nyûme gɛ. Bo mo bo shee bo gee bintanyɛ bo kaase bo tuu fo biluŋ le biluŋ le, njɛ taŋlo bintanyɛ biyu gê bamii baa bò kɛɛŋse bo too fɛ Nyo le, ki bo yûude bo gɛɛne bo mɛɛse sɛŋ gɛ.

Nɛ gɛ̀ bee lɛ bintanyɛ biyu taŋlo bi ge bo yûude noo, tu gɛ bo gɛ̀ bee bo ka bo shee bo gee bintanyɛ bi le bi le gɛ, nje bamii ba buune Nyo gɛ̀ bee nyû ba chugɛ wa bimbefɛ biboo kimimia, muntele muboo ka sage gɛ bo yi bimbefɛ le gɛ.
Geenɛ, bintanyɛ binɛ bì bo gɛ̀ gee, gɛ̀ gee bamii kwaji lo bimbefɛ biboo biluŋ le biluŋ le.
Fi le noo, nje gɛ taŋlo bilɛmɛ bi banaa
bɛ bi bí chûgɛ bimbefɛ bi muh gɛ.
Nɛ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ ge lɛ Kletu doo wu to fɛkuu fɛnɛ wu jɛmɛ Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ wo kɛme ntaŋ fɛ bintanyɛ bì ba gee bɛ nyáŋ le gɛ,
mo fɛ mwɛɛ mù ba nyaa wo le gɛ.
Wo le wo seesɛ nyu ye yi muh wu wuŋ fɛ mɛne.
Gɛ nyáŋ yì ba nyaa ba tone ba gee bintanyɛ yu fɛ wo le,
bɛ mwɛɛ mù ba nyaa ba gee bintanyɛ yu
ki ba chûge bimbefɛ bi bamii yu to mu gee wo yûge gɛ njoŋ gɛ.
Mɛ mo njɛme lɛ,
‘O Nyo bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, nto ki ŋgê fiɛɛ fì wo goone,
gɛh no ba saŋ kune mɛ a Ŋwa wo le.’”

content: Wu gɛ̀ ya wu jɛmɛ Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ wo baaŋ wo kɛme ntaŋ kɛnɛ wo yuge njoŋ bɛ bintanyɛ,
bɛ nnya yì ba nyaa wo le mo nyáŋ yì ba nyaa ba tonɛ ba gee bintanyɛ yu fɛ wo le,
mo mwɛɛ mù ba nyaa ba gee bintanyɛ yu,
ki ba chûge bimbefɛ bi bamii yu gɛ.”

content: Mwɛɛ munɛ bo gee bo bii no nchi goone.
No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu taa fo wu jɛmɛ Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, nto ki ŋgê fiɛɛ fì wo goone.”

content: Wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu lɛɛshɛ bintanyɛ bì kege ki wu gɛ̂ɛ bifɛŋ.
No Jiso Kletu gɛ̀ ge fiɛɛ fì Nyo gɛ̀ goone lɛ wu gê, ye ye yì wu gɛ̀ nya kimimia fi ka lo noo, yi ge besabɛŋ mo be yuude.
Chiji kintanyɛ wuchii to wu gɛɛne wu lɛme fɛ kijusɛ ke ki lɛme le aju achii wu gee bintanyɛ binɛ chikɛ le chikɛ le, njɛ bintanyɛ biyu taŋlo bi chîaasɛ bimbefɛ bi bamii lɛ sɛŋ.
Geenɛ Kletu gɛ̀ ge ke kintanyɛ kimimia ki mo ki kôjɛ ki chîaasɛ bimbefɛ bi bamii kimaga. No wu ge noo wu mo wu shii a kibo kinchiɛɛŋ ki Nyo le.
Wu le fo kɛge sege kɛɛ le, wu chiɛɛne gɛɛŋ bu sege Nyo lé wu gîŋsɛ bamii be ba kimbanɛ njɛ kitege ki bikaa bie wu tôme bikaa yi bo le.
Kintanyɛ ke kì kimimia kinɛ ki wu gê bamii ba wu gee bo yuude, bo mo bo yuude tɛ a Nyo jii gɛɛne mɛɛse segechii.
Kiyo ki Yuude jɛme tɛ besabɛŋ le ki toone fiɛɛ finɛ. Ki gɛ̀ ya ki jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Tada Nyo duu lɛ, nɛ maŋkaŋ manɛ mà nlé ŋgê ŋgwô besa bo,
ajiŋ a aju ayu le:
Nlé ŋgê ŋgɛ̂ɛ banchi baŋ a muntele muboo le,
ŋka nsâŋ a baŋkwajɛ baboo le.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo wu ka wu taa fo lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ mbaaŋ ŋka ŋkwâji bimbefɛ biboo
kɛnɛ gee chiboo chì befe gɛ.”

content: Fi mo fi nyume lɛ ba nɛ le ba lɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ bi bamii, tu gɛ ntaŋ wu mwɛɛ mù ba nyaa ba gee kintanyɛ ki ba chûge bimbefɛ bi bamii yu, ka baaŋ yu gɛ.
Besabɛŋ kɛ̂ɛŋse bee tôo mbebe yi Nyo le
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, fi mo fi nyume lɛ, kilɛmɛ ki Jiso le ki gwenyɛ wa je yì besabɛŋ taŋlo bee lee mɛɛse bee faane gɛ, bee gɛ̂ɛŋ fɛ Kijusɛ kɛɛ kì Yuude nɛ chuule le.
Besabɛŋ taŋlo bee fê a je yifiɛŋ yì nyaa kinche yì Jiso gɛ̀ gwenyi fɛ besabɛŋ le. Wu gɛ̀ gwenyi je yinɛ bɛ ye ye, fi mo fi nyu lɛ wu le wu chiaasɛ wa nju yì ba shɛŋshɛ ba baŋe kijusɛ kiyu yu.
Besabɛŋ kɛme wa chiji kintanyɛ wù baaŋ, wù lɛmɛ a yeh yi Nyo we.

No mwɛɛ munɛ le noo, besabɛŋ mo be kɛ̂ɛŋse bee tôo mbebe yi Nyo le bɛ fitele fimimia, besabɛŋ nyû be leesɛ fitele yi wu le fichii bee maŋe gɛ lo shige gɛ. Besabɛŋ kɛ̂ɛŋse nje ba le ba miasɛ wa muntele mwesa besabɛŋ bɛ kilɛmɛ ki Kletu mu tu mu yuude, mu ka sage gɛ besabɛŋ yi fiɛɛ le gɛ. Besabɛŋ ka nyu tɛ ba chugɛ wa ye yese besebɛŋ bɛ joo yì yuude.
Besabɛŋ lɛ̂me bee tɛɛme chuule yi fiɛɛ fì besabɛŋ jiiŋe fwe yi fi le, fì besabɛŋ to be jɛme bamii le kune fi. Keefɛ besabɛŋ jîine gɛ, nje muh wù gɛ̀ ka besabɛŋ lɛme yi jɛ ye le.
Besabɛŋ gôone tɛ je ki bee yûfe muntele mu muh lɛ muh ki bee kôŋe mo ki bee gêe mwɛɛ mù njoŋe.

Keefɛ besabɛŋ chînɛ ki bee tôo yi kintaashɛ le njɛ no bamii bamu le bo ja wa bo gee gɛ. Besabɛŋ yûfe lo muntele mwesa, fede munchii no besabɛŋ yɛde wa juu chì Tada wese besabɛŋ lé wu kâasɛ wu tô, le wa mbebe le.

Besabɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ besabɛŋ ja bee ka gee bimbefɛ, bee gee bee kee, besabɛŋ nyu be fi wa je yì nchiɛɛŋ, besabɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ kintanyɛ kimu ka nyume yu ki taŋlo ba ka ba gê fɛ bimbefɛ biɛsa besabɛŋ le gɛ.
Nɛ muh gee noo, wu chiɛɛne wa nyu nsa wu Nyo bɛ nfaaŋ, bɛ ŋgu wù befe wù lé wu gê wu yɛ̂ɛsɛ lo bamii ba kimbanɛ ba Nyo.
Sege muh ŋgodɛ nchi wu Musɛ, bamii lɛɛŋ bafɛɛ kɛnɛ batɛde bo tooŋ lɛ bo le bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì wu ge le, nsa mo wu koo mwɛdɛ, ba mo ba yuuyɛ lo wu ba koode gɛ yii gɛ.

Nɛ fi le noo, tu bɛŋ kwaji lɛ muh wù jode Mwa Nyo fɛkuu, wu jode tɛ kilɛmɛ ki maŋkaŋ mà Nyo gwo ki wu chûgɛ wu yu wu yûude lɛ ki le fiɛɛ fì achiji, wu naanyi tɛ Kiyo ki Yuude kì too bɛ nfih fɛ bamii le, kfuu chi ŋgɛ wù wɛɛ muh lé wu gê wu kɛ̂mɛ le wu nyûme nɛɛ?
We ŋgɛ le wu kuufe lo ye nje besabɛŋ kee muh wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Le mɛ wù lé ŋge nchvûu kichvusɛ,
nyu mɛ wù nlé ŋgê nnyâ nlaŋɛ wuboo.”

content: Wu ka wu jɛme lɛ,

content.text: “Le mɛ wù Tada wù nlé ŋgè nsâ bamii baŋ.”

content: Le fiɛɛ fì kuufe ye baaŋ ki muh gwè chiaaŋ yi Nyo wù kɛme kinche le.
Bɛŋ tâne aju a fwe a ba gɛ̀ yuusɛ bɛŋ yi fiɛɛ fi Nyo le. Bɛŋ gɛ̀ kaaŋ shɛ́ŋ bɛŋ ju bɛ baŋgɛ ba gɛ̀ too fɛ bɛŋ le.
Kife kimi gɛ̀ bee bamii gɛ̀ naanyi bɛŋ bo ka nyiɛge bɛ bɛŋ fɛ waaŋ. Kife kimi gɛ̀ bee bɛŋ gɛ̀ taashɛ bɛ bamii ba ba gɛ̀ nyaa tɛ ŋgɛ bo le a yɛɛ je le.

Bɛŋ gɛ̀ shee bɛŋ koode yii bɛ bo baa bamii ba le yi ncha le, bɛŋ fii bo. Bo gɛ̀ shee bo lode mwɛɛ mwɛna, bɛŋ gɛ̀ chinɛ yu bɛŋ tu bɛŋ yuge gɛh nyu njoŋ, nje bɛŋ gɛ̀ kee lɛ bɛŋ kɛme mwɛɛ mumu mù fede mwɛɛ nyume mù le mu mɛ gɛh mu nyûme segechii.
Noo, keefɛ bɛŋ chînɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ lɛme yu le gɛ, nje le fiɛɛ fì kɛme nlaŋɛ wù kuge.
Fiɛɛ fi fishaŋ fɛ bɛŋ le, le lɛ bɛŋ kâaŋ shɛ́ŋ, wu lɛ bɛŋ taŋlo bɛŋ gêe nyu fiɛɛ fì Nyo goone, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ fiɛɛ fì wu le wu ka besabɛŋ yu.
Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Shɛge wa shige muh wù lé ki wu tô mo wu fɛ̂sɛ.
Gɛ wu nyu wu môjɛ gɛ.
Muh waŋ wù chaaŋ lé wu gê wu kɛ̂mɛ kinche,
nje fitele fì wu lese yi ye yaŋ le.
Geenɛ, wu ja lo wu faane wu chii bikaa,
fitele fiaŋ gɛ ka fi jôŋe bɛ wu gɛ.”

content: Gɛ, besabɛŋ nyume bo baa bò chile bikaa bò lé bo gê bo lɛ̂sɛ gɛ. Besabɛŋ le bamii ba le ba leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le, ba biyo biboo lé bi gê bi bônɛ.

footnotes.text: Banaa banɛ gɛ̀ bee banaa ba bilɛŋsɛ.
